sql: SELECT COUNT(fp.posting_key) AS listings_above_median FROM fct_posting AS fp JOIN mart_comp_by_family AS mcf ON fp.family = mcf.family AND fp.seniority = mcf.seniority WHERE fp.is_open AND fp.remote_us AND fp.is_canonical_listing AND fp.comp_mid_usd > (1.5 * mcf.p50)
